scope: Bounded original-charge refund limits, atomic card refund intent/reservation, truthful provider settlement state, fair sweep and debt attention. Auth frozen/unmodified. No UI, dependency, migration, CI, commit, push, deployment, real funds or Learn changes.
invariants: Non-excess aggregate full/partial requested debt cannot exceed immutable recorded original charge, counted exactly with BigInt under purchase row plus charge-wide transaction advisory locks. Explicit verified excess debt is separate.
Original owner/provider/reference/provider transaction must match the source card request or paid fuel exception. Unknown original charge is rejected without catalogue fallback.
Reservation of card issuance, full withdrawal, refund id and customer historic wallet-credit clawback commit atomically with durable refund intent before outbound provider POST.

Pending provider acceptance/uncertain/manual-review outcomes preserve paid charge and refund_pending issuance. Only exact correlated authoritative refund lookup can mark card charge refunded after full aggregate disbursement.
Uncertain claims never resend automatically; old manual/failed debt remains visible and bounded sweeps rotate unresolved rows.

environment.isolation: Unique temporary schemas, synthetic data, test schemas dropped after completion; no production provider or money movement

validation.negativeCaseLogs: Synthetic failed refund inserts, provider response loss/timeouts, and unavailable email are expected assertions in the passing suite.

limits: Independent finance reviewer must recheck exact corrected findings before acceptance; qualified human review and provider sandbox/staging evidence remain required before production release.

No production readiness or application security claim. No live provider refund/settlement or real browser/UI validation. API exposes honest pending/review state; frontend changes were explicitly outside scope.

Full request after an earlier partial is rejected if original full amount would exceed remaining capacity; no unapproved automatic remaining-balance refund is invented. Admin can explicitly request a bounded partial remainder. Existing partial idempotency keys remain amount-based.
Started/completed/approved card issuance is rejected by refund paths; issued-card cancellation/entitlement reversal is outside this increment.
Historical charges without a usable immutable quote require support/provider reconciliation; current catalogue prices are never inferred as original money.
All non-excess reserved rows, including failed rows, conservatively retain cap capacity. Failed/uncertain effects require investigation instead of automatic cap release or resend.
Legacy over-refund anomalies are not retroactively repaired. A settled aggregate above original charge is rejected from automatic card settlement and surfaces reconciliation error.

Existing queued historical records are not migrated. New queued full/partial intents require an immutable purchase binding. The prior generic ambiguity test now seeds such an original paid card record so the same transport uncertainty behavior remains covered.

Other root-owned source sections were preserved, including authoritative provider transaction updates and optional no-provider read sweep handling. Whole-file hashes include those current integrated sections and must be invalidated if another agent changes them.
